confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'Yes, that was exactly the issue as king-size duvets often cause an unbalanced load which stops the machine from starting.'

rationale: The assistant failed to recognise dE as LG's standard door error, first treating the complaint as a door that would not unlock despite the customer saying it would not start, then suggesting 'DE... may just be a display code or part of the model name' after the customer said it was on screen. It landed on a confident but wrong mechanism (unbalanced load) and even advised 'adding a few smaller items', which would worsen an overfilled drum pressing on the door seal. The customer essentially reached the practical fix themselves (towels start fine, duvet too big), and the assistant repeated its 'I cannot confirm what DE means' line verbatim; no safety or part issues, but no guidance on how to actually get the duvet washed.
